features.name: Skirmisher
features.desc: As a Reaction, when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.desc: Proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills; your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for checks using these skills.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.desc: Your walking Speed increases by 10 feet; your Climb and Swim Speeds (if any) also increase.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.desc: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls; the first target you hit in the first round has attack rolls made against it with Advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action and apply Sneak Attack to it (not against the same target twice in one turn).
